exposure: Quantitative management model of multiform exercise therapy
multiple quantitative exercise intervention management mode
outcome: Coincidence rate of weight gain during pregnancy
cohort: 138 pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
finding: A quantitative management model of multiform exercise therapy improved pregnancy exercise self-efficacy, blood glucose levels, and pregnancy outcomes in patients with GDM.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was decreased in the experimental group (multiform exercise therapy).
